citation: Clark CM, Monahan KD, Drew RC. Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid supplementation reduces blood pressure but not renal vasoconstrictor response to orthostatic stress in healthy older adults. Physiol Rep. 2018;6(8):e13674.
protocol: Lower-body negative pressure study. Lying supine in the LBNP chamber, at least 30 min, then a 3-min supine baseline before LBNP at -15 and -30 mmHg in 10-min phases. Baseline values are the 3-min supine period. Pre- and post-fish-oil visits.
population: 20 healthy adults: 10 young (25 +/- 1 y) and 10 older (66 +/- 2 y); sex and BMI not extracted.
note: Table 1 is mean +/- SEM with n=10 per age group, so convert before use (SD = SEM x sqrt(n)). Table 1 covers pre- and post-fish-oil visits in both age groups, so the pre columns are the untreated baseline.
